name: FNPS Conservation Grant
summary: Grants of up to $5,000 for one year for applied conservation of rare or imperiled native plants and plant communities in Florida. A project must be sponsored by a chapter of the Florida Native Plant Society.

amount.note: For a 1-year period; may reapply in following years

status.quote: To qualify for a Conservation Grant, the proposed project must be sponsored by an FNPS Chapter. Contact: conservation@fnps.org Application Deadline: March 5, 2027
